# Elite Sheets

> Elite Sheets is a gradebook for South African teachers. It turns school marks into weighted term marks, CAPS levels and checked Excel reports.

Key facts:
- Each mark is converted to a percentage of its own maximum before weighting, so a 6/10 test and an 80/100 exam count as set.
- Weights must total 100%. Missing marks, wrong totals, duplicate learner numbers and invalid marks are flagged before export.
- Export: Excel (.xlsx) with Marks and Checks sheets; CSV also available.
- Marks are saved in the browser only (localStorage). They are not sent to the server.
- Pricing: free 2-week trial, then R79 a month.
- Elite Sheets does not connect to SA-SAMS. Exported marks are copied across manually.

Pages:
- Home: https://demo0ps.github.io/EliteSheets/
